Here are common SQL examples to query budget by department. Adjust table/column names to match your database.

### 1. Budget by department

```sql
SELECT
    department,
    SUM(budget) AS total_budget
FROM budgets
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department;
```

### 2. Budget by department using a departments table

```sql
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    SUM(b.budget_amount) AS total_budget
FROM departments d
JOIN budgets b
    ON d.department_id = b.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_name
ORDER BY d.department_name;
```

### 3. Budget by department for a specific year

```sql
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    SUM(b.budget_amount) AS total_budget
FROM departments d
JOIN budgets b
    ON d.department_id = b.department_id
WHERE b.budget_year = 2024
GROUP BY d.department_name
ORDER BY d.department_name;
```

### 4. Budget by department and year

```sql
SELECT
    d.department_name,
    b.budget_year,
    SUM(b.budget_amount) AS total_budget
FROM departments d
JOIN budgets b
    ON d.department_id = b.department_id
GROUP BY
    d.department_name,
    b.budget_year
ORDER BY
    b.budget_year,
    d.department_name;
```
